summary: Southwestern Public Service Co. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to issue two new series of first mortgage bonds (Series No. 13 and No. 14) due 20XX, with aggregate principal amounts and interest rates to be set at pricing. The bonds are senior secured obligations ranking equally with existing first mortgage bonds. There is no established trading market and no exchange listing is planned. The offering is underwritten by BMO, BofA, Morgan Stanley, RBC, and Wells Fargo. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary debt issuance, not a special situation. No deal terms apply as no acquisition, divestiture, or other special event is present.
